name_in_paper: Whole blood microarray analysis of gene expression

evidence.quote: For each sample, 750 ng of total RNA were hybridized to Beadchips (HumanHT-12v3 Expression Bead Chip, Illumina) that contains 48,771 probes for around 25,000 annotated genes.
Data was collected using DIVA software in an LRSII instrument (BD Biosciences).

name_in_paper: Serum cytokine levels determination using a Luminex system

evidence.quote: Cytokines were measured using a Luminex system (Luminex Corp).
we used seasonal trivalent inactivated influenza vaccination (IIV) and assayed antibody responses using the standard hemagglutinin-inhibition (HAI) assay at day 0 and 28±7 days after vaccination
IAV-specific T cells were enumerated from the BAL of IAV+ MCMV− (MCMV−) or IAV+ MCMV+ (MCMV+) mice by tetramer staining for NP, PA and PB1-specific responses.
Lung homogenates were titered by plaque assay on Madin-Darby canine kidney (MDCK) cells.
